name: describe-type
description: Describe one entity type: its attributes, relationships and allowed enum values

arguments.type: Entity type name, e.g. Animal, AgriParcel, Building

rules: omit live_data; it is verbose and can lag
enums are schema values, not proof of stored values; confirm stored values with query_entities if asked
an empty result may mean a wrong type name; retry with the exact type name from an unscoped compact listing only as a last resort
read the ontology:// resource only if enums, relationships and properties do not answer the question
template: Describe the type {{type}}. Call discover_context_meta_data with name={{type}} and pick={{args.pick}}. Report: properties (with units), relationships (and what they link to), and enums with their allowed values. Apply rules: {{rules}}.
